name: TiCATi
description:
TiCATi is a curated luxury travel platform for discovering and booking exceptional hotels and cruises worldwide. Find a hotel by name or destination, check live rates and availability for your dates, explore amenities and sustainability information, and access a direct booking link, no TiCATi account required.

Simply ask Claude what you need: “Find a luxury hotel in Paris,” “Check the live rate for Aman Tokyo from October 10 to 13,” or “Find a sustainable luxury hotel in Bali.” TiCATi helps identify the right property, checks current pricing and availability, and provides a direct path to booking.

For luxury cruises, TiCATi helps you discover voyages with exclusive guest benefits, including onboard credits, VIP amenities and upgrades. Personal concierge assistance is available via WhatsApp, WeChat or LINE.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TiCATi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TiCATi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.ticati.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is TiCATi MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, TiCATi scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TiCATi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TiCATi provides these MCP tools: build_booking_url, find_hotel_rate, get_hotel, get_price_estimate, get_rates, request_cruise_inquiry, search_destinations, search_hotel_by_name, and search_hotels.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TiCATi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to TiCATi in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
TiCATi does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
TiCATi is developed by TiCATi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
